title: Streaming token ledger for near-real-time metering and billing
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a streaming token ledger service and metering aggregation job that produces invoice-ready billing records with per-customer, per-model, and per-route attributions. This ticket scopes the backend pipeline: ingestion adapters, dedup/idempotency, windowed aggregation, persistent ledger (append-only), reconciliation hooks, and export to billing system. Goal: reduce delay between usage and billable ledger availability from hours to under 5 minutes for 95% of traffic while keeping deterministic attribution and supporting retroactive corrections.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Streaming ledger ingests validated token events (request-start, token-chunk, request-end) at 50k req/s sustained with <2% event loss; 2) Aggregation job emits per-customer daily/monthly counters consistent with existing batch jobs for a 7-day sample dataset; 3) Reconciliation job detects and corrects drift >0.1% at daily cadence and produces an audit report; 4) API endpoints to query ledger slices (customer, model, route, time-range) with consistent pagination; 5) End-to-end pipeline has dashboards and alerts and is documented in Confluence.
design_decisions:
- Use Kafka (existing infra) for ingestion to preserve ordering per-customer partition.
- Use a write-once append ledger stored in S3+Parquet for nightly cold storage and a RocksDB-backed state store for hot windowed counters.
- Implement exactly-once semantics using event dedup keys (request_id + sequence) and idempotent writes to state store.
- Aggregation windows: rolling 1m and 5m windows for near-real-time metrics, and a canonical daily bucket for billing exports.
- Reconciliation: nightly batch-run comparing hot counters to canonical daily aggregates; generate correction patches applied as compensating events.
- Expose a read-only ledger API on Console backend scoped to service accounts with RBAC for support and finance teams.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): route 1% of production traffic to streaming ledger and run in parallel with existing batch metering (no billing impact) for 2 weeks; Phase 2: increase to 25% and validate reconciliation; Phase 3: 100% ingestion, but continue using batch export as fallback for 30 days; Phase 4: flip billing exports to new ledger if reconciliation within thresholds for 7 consecutive days. Rollback plan: revert to batch export, drain new consumers, and replay Kafka topics from last known-good offset.
monitoring_and_alerts: Dashboards: ingestion rps, event lag (broker -> consumer), per-partition consumer lag, dedup rate, aggregation throughput, reconciliation drift pct, export success rate. Alerts: consumer lag > 30s (P0), reconciliation drift > 0.5% (P0), export failure rate > 1% sustained 10m (P1), ledger API error rate > 0.5% (P1). Integrations: PagerDuty for P0, Slack #infra-billing for P1.
test_plan: Unit tests for dedup logic and aggregator windowing; integration test harness that replays historical request traces; load test in staging at 2x expected QPS; synthetic drift injection to test reconciliation and compensating events; end-to-end smoke with finance team using sample invoices; run compliance data export to validate KMS-encrypted storage configuration.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Asha: Initial spike completed. Verified Kafka partitioning by customer_id yields even distribution for current tenant mix. Prototype stores hot state in RocksDB and writes daily Parquet snapshots to S3.

2026-02-28 - Liam: Design review feedback: tighten exactly-once guarantees by including producer epoch in dedup key and add end-to-end encryption for PII-sensitive fields. Also requested cost estimate for RocksDB replication under 3x traffic scenario.

2026-03-03 - Eng arch: Agreed on append-only ledger plus hot state approach. Decided to keep canonical billing export in Parquet (date partitioned) to simplify finance ingestion. Noted trade-off: small latency vs stronger consistency; prioritized deterministic corrections over sub-second billing accuracy.

2026-03-05 - QA: Added test cases for out-of-order chunks, missing request-end events, and duplicate replays from producer restarts. Found edge-case where aggregated token counts were off by +1 for requests truncated on consumer restart — fixed by stricter sequence validation.

2026-03-09 - Finance (review): Provided sample mapping for their billing engine fields; requested additional per-model breakdown fields (model_family and quantization_tag) to be included in daily export. Action: add tags to aggregation schema.
